title: Re-Test Hours on Work Conditioning and Work Hardening Program Days
content:
# Re-test hours on program days

**Standard.** On a program day of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral, re-test hours added to the day are two (2) where at least twice the program's progress-report interval has passed since the latest progress report sent to the adjuster (or since the initial evaluation where none has been sent), one (1) where at least one interval but less than two has passed, and none otherwise.

The initial evaluation is the date of service of the referral's evaluation charge. Time is measured in calendar days.

## The interval for each program

| Program | Progress-report interval | One interval reached at | Two intervals reached at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Work Conditioning Program | 14 calendar days | 14 days | 28 days |
| Work Hardening Program | 7 calendar days | 7 days | 14 days |

## Bands

| Calendar days since the latest progress report (or the initial evaluation where none sent) | Re-test hours added |
|---|---|
| fewer than one interval | none |
| at least one interval, fewer than two | 1 |
| two intervals or more | 2 |

## Boundary cases

| Program | Days since latest progress report | Re-test hours |
|---|---|---|
| Work Conditioning Program | 13 | none |
| Work Conditioning Program | 14 | 1 |
| Work Conditioning Program | 27 | 1 |
| Work Conditioning Program | 28 | 2 |
| Work Hardening Program | 6 | none |
| Work Hardening Program | 7 | 1 |
| Work Hardening Program | 13 | 1 |
| Work Hardening Program | 14 | 2 |

Where no progress report has been sent on the referral, the same bands are read from the initial evaluation.
